source_evidence: Exact player 'Actually you might have a job waiting for you near Miregate then' initiates possible work discussion with the shipwright's adult daughter after successful skiff recovery. NPC has independent family/business responsibilities, interest but no commitment. No assumption of specific job or Miregate vacancy; no new expense, dice or estate change.  At D326~13:50 V tells shipwright's daughter exactly 'Actually you might have a job waiting for you near Miregate then'. She is interested in hearing about possible river work but helps run her father's active boatyard and will not abandon existing obligations on a vague offer. Asks what kind of work V has in mind, whether a particular boat/job or regular operation; willing to consider a commission or ongoing arrangement if mutually workable. No hiring, contract, wage, voyage, move, estate expense, staffing promise or task accepted; no roll or time skip. The previous offer of a pilot/downstream pickup remains. Await V's explanation; no further movement or paymaster visit.
pending_action: D326~13:50 Orsaven boatyard, V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar on quay with proprietor/daughter and workers, coach/four horses at Copper Hart. R2 V exact 'just attack' authorizes ordinary ranged Psychic Blade only. Attack genuine d20 2+9=11 hits AC8, d6 face2+4=6 psychic, Large Ochre Jelly HP6→0; dead, no Split, no further hostile turns, no Vex, BA, Sneak Attack, reactions, spell slots or extra resources spent. Combat completed D326~13:36, both V and Cirren unharmed. Single 2014 MM Ochre Jelly defeated; R1 1MP already spent, no additional expenditure. Under previously accepted skiff help and fixed prep dm-ferry-i.md, after actual threat removal Fenar willingly works the line/lifting eye with yard workers while a competent worker seats replacement pin, correct leverage with no pressure means no roll; boom visibly lifted and rescue skiff released, routine cleanup of dead ooze handled by yard with due caution. No V action, hazard, purchase, wage, fee or reward invented. Daughter thanks party and offers future pilot/downstream pickup on a later crossing if arranged, no journey or service accepted or booked. Shipwright's original receipted bill and Quenwood guarantee previously revealed: two lost ferries, promised eighth of net evening earnings, beneficiary account4-C payment on guarantee; shipwright unaware source when paid; replacement operation active. Paymaster at ordinary ferry landing is next available lead, no current share sum, recipient, restitution or operator complicity established. Quenwood life imprisonment upheld, restitution unpaid. V has not yet visited paymaster; await next action.
